This is the baseline we measure against at 30, 60 and 90 days.

findings.title: Ramtech is absent from the top ten for the national head terms that carry the volume
findings.evidence: Live from Mansfield, Ramtech does not appear in the top ten for "modular construction" (modular.org #1, wikipedia.org #2, woodworks.org #3), "prefabricated" (wikipedia.org #1), "portable school buildings" (mobilemodular.com #1, willscot.com #2, boxxmodular.com #3) or "best modular building company mansfield" (buttershomesinc.com #1). findings.fix: Add a five to eight question FAQ block, marked up as FAQPage, to /relocatable-modular-buildings/, /permanent-modular-construction/, /modular-school-buildings/, /medical-building/, /government-building/, /modular-offices/ and /leasing/, using the cost, timeline and risk questions buyers actually ask. In the build.
findings.cost: Perplexity recommends Ramtech from third-party pages such as modular.org, mapquest.com and iqsdirectory.com rather than from Ramtech's own words, so the description of what Ramtech does is written by directories, not by Ramtech.
findings.title: No page on the site answers a question in a format an engine can lift
findings.evidence: Zero of 33 service, industry and location pages carry five or more questions marked up as FAQPage, and only 7 of those 33 use a question as a heading. findings.fix: Build a location template and publish pages for the Texas metros Ramtech actually serves, each with the services offered, a named local project from the existing portfolio, an FAQ marked up as FAQPage and LocalBusiness schema. In the 30-day plan, with the template in the build.
findings.cost: Mansfield is won and is small. The surrounding Texas market, where school districts and healthcare buyers search by city, has no page to land on, so those searches go to mobilemodular.com, willscot.com and ariesbuildings.com.
findings.title: There is not a single location page, and no city appears in a title

findings.fix: Replace the Article block with Service schema on each of the seven service and industry money pages, naming the service, the provider and the area served, and add the url property to the Organization block on the home page. In the build.
findings.cost: An engine reading these pages sees news articles about buildings, not services a company sells, so Ramtech is harder to match to a buying query than a competitor whose markup says what is for sale.
findings.title: Not one page on the site carries Service schema
findings.evidence: The crawl reports 371 of 405 buyer and blog pages carry Service or Article schema, but on inspection every money page is marked up as Article, not Service: /relocatable-modular-buildings/, /permanent-modular-construction/, /modular-school-buildings/, /medical-building/, /government-building/, /modular-offices/ and /leasing/ all return service: false. findings.fix: Publish answer pages for the cost, timeline, comparison and risk questions on the blog, each opening with a direct answer in the first 40 words, and cross-link them from the matching service page. In the 30-day plan; re-ask the same 50 questions at 60 and 90 days.
findings.cost: On the generic buying questions, how much does it cost, who are the top providers, which companies are best, Ramtech is absent and the cited pages belong to modulargenius.com, triumphmodular.com, mobilemodular.com and boxxmodular.com. findings.title: Two of four answer engines failed and one named Ramtech only from directories
findings.evidence: Of 50 questions, Claude with web search (claude-sonnet-5) answered 27, named Ramtech in 9 and cited ramtechmodular.com in 10. OpenAI with web search (gpt-4.1) and Gemini with Google Search (gemini-3.8-flash) each failed all 50 on billing errors, so they are not evidence either way. At least one engine named Ramtech in 14 of 50 and cited the site in 10. today: Semrush credits ramtechmodular.com with 2,084 organic keywords and about 2,343 visits a month, on an Authority Score of 24 and a domain rank of 589,691.
Branded searches are 11 percent of that traffic, so nearly nine visits in ten come from people who did not type the company name.

The home page title runs to 72 characters, "Ramtech | Relocatable Modular Buildings & Permanent Modular Construction", and the H1 is the claim "RAMTECH IS A DESIGN-BUILD LEADER IN MODULAR BUILDING CONSTRUCTION", which contains no search term a buyer would use.

Every money page carries Article schema, not one carries Service or FAQPage markup, not one shows a review, and the home page has no form on it despite HubSpot being installed sitewide.

Live searches run from Mansfield on 12 November 2026 put Ramtech first for six of the seven local service searches, absent from the top ten for "best modular building company mansfield", and fourth for its own brand name with "reviews".
Phone speed is adequate overall at a median 76, but the main content takes longer than 2.5 seconds on all six money pages tested, 2,950 ms on the five service pages and 3,437 ms on the home page.

hub.intro: Measured on 12 November 2026 before anything was changed, so the work can be judged against it. Numbers from Semrush, live searches run from Mansfield, Texas, and a crawl of all 635 pages.
today: Semrush credits ramtechmodular.com with 2,084 organic keywords and about 2,343 visits a month, on an Authority Score of 24 and a domain rank of 589,691.
Branded searches are 11 percent of that traffic, so nearly nine visits in ten come from people who did not type the company name.

The home page title runs to 72 characters, "Ramtech | Relocatable Modular Buildings & Permanent Modular Construction", and the H1 is the claim "RAMTECH IS A DESIGN-BUILD LEADER IN MODULAR BUILDING CONSTRUCTION", which contains no search term a buyer would use.

Four pages carry most of the traffic: the home page at 11.77 percent, /modular-school-buildings/modular-portable-classrooms/ at 11.52 percent, /relocatable-modular-buildings/ at 11.13 percent and /education-floor-plans/ at 8.53 percent.
Every money page carries Article schema, not one carries Service or FAQPage markup, not one shows a review, and the home page has no form on it despite HubSpot being installed sitewide.
The site is 635 pages with an average page score of 49 out of 100, and 424 of those pages score D or F.

Live searches run from Mansfield on 12 November 2026 put Ramtech first for six of the seven local service searches, absent from the top ten for "best modular building company mansfield", and fourth for its own brand name with "reviews".
after: Every URL that earns a visitor today keeps earning it: a permanent redirect for each page that exists now, tested one by one before launch (the table below).
A home page whose title and first heading name what a buyer searches for, with a form on it, and the company's own claim kept as the supporting line.
Service and FAQPage markup on every money page in place of Article markup, with five to eight questions on each.
Titles that name Mansfield, Arlington and Dallas-Fort Worth where Ramtech sells, and an llms.txt at the root so assistants resolve the company correctly.
Pages for the four markets and the two ways to build, each broken into question headings with the answer first.
The same measurement repeated at 30, 60 and 90 days, shared with you in full.
hub.note: Rankings and traffic depend on the market and on what you publish after launch. What we commit to is that nothing about the build is the reason they do not come, that every number above is re-measured at 30, 60 and 90 days, and that you see the same report we do.

sitewide: Every page is served over HTTPS, and http, https, www and the bare domain all end on one address.
robots.txt is readable and all 13 crawlers tested are allowed in, including GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot and Google-Extended.
There is no llms.txt at the root of the site.
One sitemap lists all 635 pages, every listed page answers directly, and the dates are credible across 110 different days with the newest at 12 November 2026.
Organization schema is on the home page but the block has no url property, so it does not tie the company to the site.
LocalBusiness markup is present as GeneralContractor with a readable Mansfield address and the phone number 817-873-3675.
A branded share image is set on 417 of 418 buyer pages and the social sharing tags are complete on all 418.
Forms run through HubSpot, but only /leasing and /awards carry one among the buyer pages tested, and the home page has none.
A canonical tag is present on 635 of 635 pages and points at the page itself on every money page.
No page carries an unintended noindex, and all 635 URLs answered the crawler with a 200.
The average page holds 333 words and 333 of 635 pages sit under 300, including /scif-buildings/ at 152 and /building-product-types/ at 155.
Internal linking is weak in three ways: 460 body links use empty or generic text, 23 pages have nothing linking to them, and only 89 of 418 buyer pages sit within three clicks of the home page.

assumptions: Paid budgets assume 5% of searches click the top ad, at Semrush's cost per click for the term.
A term counts as out of reach organically when the site is past the twentieth result, or is unranked against a difficulty above 30.
Brand terms are never counted as wasted spend: defending them is deliberate.
Click-through by position: 27% at first, 10% at third, 2% at tenth, 1% from eleventh to twentieth, and effectively nothing beyond.
The plan aims at position 3, not position 1.
Search volume and cost per click are Semrush figures for the client's database, not guesses.
Paid budgets assume 5% of searches click the top ad.

"Reachable" is judged against this client's own Semrush Authority Score, not a fixed difficulty threshold: a term is reachable when their authority meets its difficulty, or when they already rank inside the top twenty and are within twenty points of it. Authority Score and Keyword Difficulty are different scales that share a range, so this is a working rule rather than a measurement.
